candidate_decisions.reason: The trusted channel nomination has focus carriers for adopted allies, substitution, enmity, and support, plus independent context carriers for witnessing, strengthening, calling, response, separation, entrapment, and diversion. Every listed branch lands, and the pericope changes the focus into an operational failure test while preserving its plain warning.

The four focus branches form a bounded relation in which adopting enemies as allies makes the replacement itself the condemned exchange. Adoption, support, enmity, and substitution are each carried by an exact focus occurrence and remain materially distinct from the later pericope-wide failure tests.

The exact HFT trace names supplied 18:45 and 18:46 coordinates, roots, roles, and returns through the focus offspring and ally surfaces. The legacy_unbound provenance qualifies the causal succession inference but does not suppress any traced branch.

The exact HFT trace ties the supplied exposure and accounting coordinates in 18:47 and 18:49 to the focus hidden enemy and adopted relation. All seven trace roles agree with the supplied context roots and return through the focus, so they survive as attributed evidence.

The exact HFT trace matches the focus adoption and management roles with the supplied 18:51 misguidance and supporting-arm coordinates. Its revised operational-support reading is retained with the live alternative that the next ayah only denies divine need.

The exact HFT trace matches the focus nearness/support carrier with every supplied 18:52 calling, partnership, response, distance, and barrier coordinate. The trace returns through the focus and is retained as attributed evidence with its false-partnership alternative visible.

The exact HFT trace matches the supplied focus departure-from-command and 18:53 falling and denied-diversion coordinates. The proposed trajectory is retained as attributed evidence, while a purely rhetorical contrast remains live.

The exact HFT trace matches the focus adoption, misplacement, substitution, and the 18:56 truth, sign, and mockery coordinates. The repeated role-assignment mechanism is retained with the alternative that the repeated verb does not make the two cases one operation.

The exact HFT trace matches the focus hiddenness and nearness coordinates with the supplied 18:57 forgetting, heart, covering, understanding, and hearing roles. Its internal-filter reading is retained as exploratory attributed evidence, with the independent-judgment alternative kept visible.

The exact HFT trace matches the focus support, alternative-placement, misplacement, and substitution coordinates with the 18:58 refuge and appointment and 18:59 destruction coordinates. The delayed refuge failure is retained as attributed contextual evidence.

findings.title: Chosen allies fail successive tests
findings.claim: The allies chosen in place of God are exposed as a support claim that fails across the pericope: they are absent as witnesses, cannot strengthen, do not answer a summons, and leave their claimants without a route out.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms for adopting, substituting, taking allies, and naming enmity meet the supplied 18:51-18:53 witnessing, support, summons, nonresponse, barrier, and diversion carriers. Their contact turns the focus choice into a sequence of functional tests.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing condemnation becomes concrete: the alleged source of protection is tested by presence, reinforcement, response, and escape, and fails at each point.
findings.containment: The focus remains a warning about choosing hostile allies as substitutes. The operational sequence is a bounded pericope reading, not a surah-wide system, and the uncertain-assertion branch does not establish the claimants' certainty as a fact.

epistemic.reason: The channel source and its branch nominations are trusted, while the operational sequence is a bounded synthesis of the supplied focus and context contacts.

branch_activations.activation: Adoption contacts the selected ally and the named enemy status, so taking becomes the act whose practical result can be examined.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus choice opens a sequence in which the adopted allies must demonstrate the support they claim to provide.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus verb remains deliberate adoption; no general sense of acquisition is asserted.

branch_activations.activation: Substitution contacts a role that requires protection and a substitute named as hostile, making the exchange testable rather than merely different.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The chosen allies are not only another option; they are a replacement whose performance can fail against the role they replace.
branch_activations.boundary: No general theory of all substitution is claimed; the relation is limited to this protective exchange.

findings.title: False allies are an evil substitute
findings.claim: The focus presents hostile allies as a replacement for proper protection whose failure is already contained in the exchange itself.
findings.mechanism: The focus adoption, ally, enemy, and substitution carriers meet in one sentence: a relation meant to provide support is deliberately assigned to an enemy and named as a replacement. The contact changes badal from a generic change into a failed role exchange.
findings.reader_payoff: The final badal word makes the warning intelligible as a transaction: the wrong party is installed where protection was expected.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains that taking Iblis and his offspring as allies is a bad choice. This finding does not absorb the separate later tests of witnessing, answering, or escape.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches and trusted channel support are supplied, while the role-exchange synthesis is bounded to their contact in 18:50.

branch_activations.activation: Adoption contacts the hostile ally relation and makes the choice an intentional installation rather than a neutral encounter.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The wrong protector is deliberately taken into the place of a needed protector.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not generalize the focus verb beyond the supplied adoption relation.

findings.containment: The ordinary reference to Iblis's offspring remains primary. The propagation image is attributed contextual evidence and does not assert that the offspring literally become vegetation or dust.

epistemic.reason: All coordinates and root strings are supplied and match the lean context records, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the succession arrow is an attributed inference.

findings.containment: The ordinary focus reading that Iblis and his offspring are hostile allies remains present. The functional test is an attributed pericope relation and may also expose false partnership generally rather than only this alliance.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates and roots are exact and complete, while the causal test from focus nearness to contextual separation is explicitly attributed.

friction_notes: The eight HFT records are parseable and their supplied ayah, word-index, root, attributed-role, and focus-return coordinates agree with the packet. Reader identity remains legacy_unbound, so the causal arrows are retained as attributed or exploratory rather than independently lexicalized; unresolved HFT branches keep null gloss and facet fields.

The packet supplies exact Arabic and lean root coordinates for non-focus context ayat but not their full target morphology. Contextual activations therefore preserve the supplied roles and boundaries without inventing additional morphology.

The explicit external ayat were quarantined during phase 1. Phase 2 retained only the two bounded contacts through 18:50:15:1 and 18:50:18:1; 1:3, 1:4, 1:6, and 1:7 supplied no compatible additional focus contact that materially changed the reading.

Connection prior labels and reciprocal notes were treated as provenance rather than ranking. Counter-evidence remains contained in the finding boundaries, and no connection was used as an automatic acceptance decision.
